instruction: Grip the the mouse with curved top and move it onto the Gray mat.
Use the left arm to pick the oval-shaped mouse and place it on the Yellow mat.
With the right arm, grab the dark gray mouse and position it on the Green mat.
Use the right arm to pick up the palm-sized playingcards carton and push it outward.
Pick up the yellow and red playingcards box and move it away.
Use the left arm to grab the small black box with cards and move it away.
Grab the hamburg with printed illustrations and the Bright red box with fries inside and position them on the medium dark brown tray.
Move the yellow hamburg box and the red fries packet with dual arms to the smooth light beige plastic tray.
With dual arms, move the hamburg with white patches and the Open-top red box filled with fries onto the beige tray.
Grab the hand-held sauce container, shift it, and place it close to the kitchenpot with two side handles
Use the left arm to lift the red sauce can, then move it next to the black kitchenpot with round lid
Use the left arm to pick the plastic lid sauce can up and set it beside the kitchenpot with smooth exterior
Use the left arm to grab the soft brown bread and drop it inside the medium woven breadbasket.
Simultaneously grab the doughy and soft bread and the bread loaf with bumpy surface using the dual arm, then drop them in the brown breadbasket.
Simultaneously grab the bread with golden crust and the sponge-textured golden bread using the right arm, then drop them in the beige basket for holding bread.
Grab the medium white shoe from the table with the right arm and place it on the mat
Use the left arm to lift the brown sole shoe from the table and set it on the mat
Use the right arm to pick up the white shoe with three stripes from the table and drop it on the mat
Grab the Coca-Cola can with the left arm, put it into the yellow basket for carrying stuff, and lift the yellow basket for carrying stuff with the other arm.
Lift the can with red-orange text, place it in the basket with black handle, and raise the basket with black handle.
Drop the green red metallic soda can into the medium yellow basket with slots using the left arm, then lift the medium yellow basket with slots with another arm.
Lift the long thin bottle using the right arm and hold upright
Hold the medium green bottle upright after lifting with the right arm
Use the left arm to hold the medium-sized green bottle from the table
Grab the miniature bright green toycar using the left arm and place it left of the playingcards storage box.
Set the small blue car-shaped toycar directly to the left of the blue playingcards box
Grab the mouse for cursor control using the left arm and move left of the pink toycar shaped like real car
Move the metallic phone with glass screen front onto the angled green phone support.
Take the smooth-screen phone to the phonestand with slot.
Carry the rectangular phone with rounded corners to the curved phonestand with phone slot.
Use the right arm to press the white and black colored bell's top section.
Make the right arm interact with the smooth blue bell's top center.
Have the left arm click at the bell with brown base's top center.
Move the palm-sized bottle with orange cover and drop it on the pad
Take the teal-bottom bottle with cylindrical body and place it onto the pad
Pick the cylindrical bottle with ridged white lid with the right arm and drop it onto the pad.
With two arms, pick the easy-to-hold hamburg and the French fries in red packaging for the flat tray with smooth surface.
With dual arms, move the hamburg with white patches and the Open-top red box filled with fries onto the beige tray.
Put the foldable hamburg cardboard box and the golden fries in smooth red pouch on the medium rectangular flat tray using both arms
Push down on the stapler with orange button to staple papers.
Firmly push the handheld blue and silver stapler using the right arm to operate it.
Use an arm to press the smooth plastic stapler
Take hold of the roller with smooth texture.
Grab the brown roller directly from the table.
Take hold of the narrow tapered roller using your arms.
